About the Hiring Team

What the Role Entails
Tencent Games was established in 2003. We are a leading global platform for game development, operations and publishing, and the largest online game community in China. Excellent material writing ability, excellent execution
Ability to take initiatives and drive to insights, owning workstreams end to end 
Avid gamer and genuine passion for games, curiosity about the broader entertainment industry and willing to share (we need "your perspective")
Good interpersonal skills and teamwork spirit, resilience
Proficient with AI tools and familiar with AI workflow automation
